About this Event

Yoga in the Park - IndianapolisJoin us for a relaxing Yoga session led by certified yoga instructor, Jordan McCurdy, followed by curated swag bags and meaningful community connections at a scenic outdoor location in central Indy! It's happening again on Saturday, November 14, 2026 at 10:00 AM (EST). Whether you're a beginner or a pro, come stretch, breathe, and enjoy the fresh air with fellow yoga lovers. Don't forget your mat and water bottle. See you there for some good vibes, great moves, and free goodies!
